description: Describes the tags defined in the NMOS Parameter Registers. May be applied to the tags property of any resource.
title: Tags

urn:x-nmos:tag:asset:manufacturer/v1.0.description: The name used by the company or other organisation creating/selling an Asset. Exactly one value, as specified by AMWA BCP-002-02.

urn:x-nmos:tag:asset:product/v1.0.description: The name given by the Manufacturer for the Asset. Exactly one value, as specified by AMWA BCP-002-02.

urn:x-nmos:tag:asset:instance-id/v1.0.description: The identifier that distinguishes Assets that have the same Product Name. Exactly one value, as specified by AMWA BCP-002-02.

urn:x-nmos:tag:asset:function/v1.0.description: The name of the function implemented by a Device within its Node. At least one value, as specified by AMWA BCP-002-02.

urn:x-nmos:tag:grouphint/v1.0.description: The groups to which the resource belongs. Each value is either an empty string or has the form <group-name>:<role-in-group>[:<group-scope>], where group-scope is device or node.

urn:x-nmos:tag:certprov.description: The versions of AMWA BCP-003-03 that are enabled on the Node. Each value has the form v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.

urn:x-vsf:tag:tr-09-2:booking-list/v1.0.description: The VSF TR-09-2 bookings associated with the shared resource. Each value has the form <consumer-id>:<booking-id>:<element-id>[:<label>].

urn:x-vsf:tag:tr-09-2:current-booking/v1.description: The currently active VSF TR-09-2 booking for the shared resource, if any. The value has the form <consumer-id>:<booking-id>.
